summary: Configures automatic conversation compaction on the Responses API. When the request reaches the optional compact_threshold, OpenAI replaces older context with a compaction item instead of waiting for context overflow.
combines: The field is defined on Responses requests and is absent from Chat Completions requests.
Each entry uses type compaction and may set compact_threshold to choose when compaction starts.
The reviewed GPT-5.4 through GPT-5.6 families support Responses. GPT-5.5 carries forward GPT-5.4 compaction support, and the GPT-5.6 guidance keeps Responses as the recommended stateful workflow.
